Can you describe the position of your body when you started to pass out, and do you have a history of heart murmurs or previous fainting spells?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Vasovagal Syncope (Micturition Syncope)

The normal ECG and electrolytes, combined with the loss of consciousness occurring immediately after voiding without cardiac symptoms, strongly suggest micturition syncope caused by a sudden drop in blood pressure.
